correctness.rationale: The fixed-time step is reproved using scalar p-moment convergence plus a triangular weak law across iid coordinates, so no 2p moment is used there. The dynamic remainder is Jin's martingale Q; its squared integrand contains exactly the moment order 2p-2, and independence yields E|Q_n|^2=O(n^p/d). Doob control, monotonicity of the convex remainder, stationary block increments, and the standard Gromov--Hausdorff correspondence complete the proof. The argument covers every sequence d(n) tending to infinity.

value.rationale: The source explicitly flags its stronger moment demand at p=2, and the same 2p requirement restricts heavy-tailed examples for all p. In the canonical iid-coordinate model, the theorem separates the cross-coordinate concentration issue from temporal martingale control and lowers the required tail order by two for p>2 and to finite variance for 1<p<2, without imposing any rate relation between n and d. This is a natural structural extension rather than a parameter substitution.
